description: This file implements the core operational functions of a Web Module Container Object, including functions to ignite, deactivate, and switch the module on or off. It defines functions for engaging the module operations, canceling actions, and toggling the module state, indicating its role in managing the lifecycle and operational state of the web module within a larger web server/client application.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebMcoIgnite(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Engages or activates the web module container object by registering its interfaces.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebMcoPutOut(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Deactivates or cancels operations of the web module container object; currently a no-op.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebMcoSwitch(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bSwitchOn)
methods.description: Switches the web module container object on or off by engaging or canceling its web server object.
